detailed_description: 2D-animated, painterly anime background art with soft cel-shaded figures and clean thin dark-brown line art. [Shot 1] An insert at the height of the umbrella stand's rim, the camera low and close. A dented brass umbrella stand fills the lower half of the frame, its round mouth just below centre. Out of it rise three umbrella handles: two black plastic handles at the left and, in the centre, the curved bamboo crook handle of <Subject 1>, its furled mustard-yellow canopy disappearing into the stand. Entering from the upper right edge of the frame, the right hand of <Subject 2>, a man in his seventies, reaches down: a thin, bony old hand with prominent knuckles, loose creased skin over the back and a few pale brown age spots, the loose gray wool cardigan cuff hanging over the wrist and halfway down the back of the hand, with the palm turned toward the camera, the fingers already curled around the bamboo crook, the thumb on its top. The bamboo handle is the brightest, warmest point in the frame, lit amber from above; the background beyond the stand falls into soft dark wood and a blur of blue from the door's glass.
